content.about: Equatorial Guinea is a small country on Central Africa's coast, made up of a mainland region and islands. Its capital, Malabo, is on Bioko Island. Rainforests and volcanic mountains cover its land. Oil has become its main industry.

standout.text: Equatorial Guinea is the only African country where Spanish is an official language.

didYouKnow: Its island of Annobón is far out in the Atlantic.
It is one of Africa's smallest countries.
